regulations.context: Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES
Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES

requirements.description: The ACCOMPANYING DOCUMENT includes a description of the correction method to derive unadjusted temperatures from OUTPUT TEMPERATURE measured in the ADJUSTED MODE, except when the CLINICAL THERMOMETER is equipped with a TEST MODE or DIRECT MODE
Protection against electrical HAZARDS from ME EQUIPMENT
Protection against mechanical HAZARDS of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEMS
Protection against unwanted and excessive radiation HAZARDS
Protection against excessive temperatures and other HAZARDS
requirements.reference: IEC 60601-1:2005+A1:2012, Clause 11 applies except as follows

requirements.description: Cleaning and disinfection of ME EQUIPMENT and ME SYSTEM

sub_requirements.description: The surfaces of the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES that can become contaminated with body fluids during NORMAL CONDITION or SINGLE FAULT CONDITION shall be designed to allow for cleaning and disinfection or cleaning and sterilization
The CLINICAL THERMOMETER may be dismantled during the decontamination PROCESS
ACCESSORIES not intended for re-use are exempt from this requirement

CLINICAL THERMOMETER and PROBE ENCLOSURES shall be designed to allow for surface cleaning and disinfection to reduce to acceptable levels the RISK of infection of OPERATORS, bystanders, or the PATIENT
Instructions for processing and REPROCESSING the CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE and ACCESSORIES shall comply with ISO 17664:2004 and ISO 14937:2009 and shall be disclosed in the instructions for use

Check compliance by inspection of the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Clean and disinfect 100 times in accordance with the methods indicated in the instruction for use, including any cooling or drying period. After these PROCEDURES, confirm that BASIC SAFETY and ESSENTIAL PERFORMANCE are maintained.

requirements.description: Biocompatibility of ME EQUIPMENT and ME

sub_requirements.description: ACCESSIBLE PARTS of a CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE, its parts or ACCESSORIES that contain phthalates which are classified as carcinogenic, mutagenic or toxic to reproduction shall be marked as containing phthalates on the device itself or on the packaging

If INTENDED USE includes treatment of children or treatment of pregnant or nursing women, a specific justification for the use of phthalates shall be included in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. Instructions for use shall contain information on RESIDUAL RISKS for these PATIENT groups and appropriate precautionary measures.

Confirm that the MANUFACTURER has evaluated the effects of multiple PROCESS cycles and the effectiveness of those cycles as part of the 100-cycle cleaning/disinfection compliance verification.

If the INTENDED USE of a CLINICAL THERMOMETER, PROBE, its parts or ACCESSORIES includes treatment of children or treatment of pregnant or nursing women, a specific justification for the use of phthalates shall be included in the RISK MANAGEMENT FILE. The instructions for use shall contain information on RESIDUAL RISKS for these PATIENT groups and, if applicable, on appropriate precautionary measures.
